claim: Felling yields are stored on each tree: Ash, Pine, Winter Pine, Cypress, Willow and Dead Tree give 4 Logs after 6 chops; Jungle Tree (big) 5 after 6; Mesquite 2 after 3; Jungle Bush 1 after 3; orchard trees 1 Log after 3 chops; the Nopal Tree 1 Log and 5 Nopal.

evidence.reference: FormulaStepBehaviour "-> Wood" on each tree prefab workspot (Ash 299687: 4 Wood, WorkIterations 6; AppleTree 303246: 1 Wood, 3). Decoded with the pure-Python IL2CPP reader; exported as decoded-mechanics.json plants.

notes: Logs are the resource the game calls Wood internally. Chops are work actions, not seconds.
